nodes.name: help_links.js
nodes.summary: Static map of contextual help links (frappe.help.help_links) keyed by route/DocType form pointing to external docs. Consumed by the Desk help menu.

nodes.name: logout.js
nodes.summary: Tiny module exposing frappe.app.logout() which calls /api/method/logout and reloads the page.

nodes.name: number_format.js
nodes.summary: Locale aware numeric/currency formatting and parsing. Implements flt, fmt_money, format_number, get_number_format_info, _round with multiple rounding methods (banker's, commercial), precision lookup against cur_frm, and currency-fraction aware rounding.

nodes.name: flt
nodes.summary: Coerces arbitrary value to float, strips locale number-format group/decimal separators, optionally rounds to given precision and rounding method.

nodes.name: strip_number_groups
nodes.summary: Removes thousands group separators and converts the locale decimal marker to '.'.

nodes.name: format_number
nodes.summary: Formats number with locale-specific thousand groups (including Indian lakh grouping), decimal separator and precision.

nodes.name: format_currency
nodes.summary: Formats currency value with symbol placement on left/right depending on boot settings.

nodes.name: _round
nodes.summary: Precision rounding supporting Banker's Rounding and Commercial Rounding with sign handling and epsilon adjustments.

nodes.name: round_based_on_smallest_currency_fraction
nodes.summary: Rounds monetary value to nearest multiple of currency smallest fraction (e.g., 0.05).

nodes.name: fmt_money
nodes.summary: High-level money formatter used by reports/forms; combines format_number with currency symbol and negative-sign handling.

nodes.name: number_systems.js
nodes.summary: Defines named large-number scales (default: thousand/million/billion/trillion; indian: lakh/crore) used by format_number to render abbreviated values.

nodes.name: pretty_date.js
nodes.summary: Human readable relative time strings ('3 minutes ago', 'in 2 days'). Exposes comment_when and prettyDate; uses moment internally and is translation aware.

nodes.name: prettyDate
nodes.summary: Converts ISO timestamp to localized relative 'x ago' / 'in x' string based on diff buckets.

nodes.name: preview_email.js
nodes.summary: frappe.utils.get_email_preview: renders a server-supplied email template preview in a dialog so users can validate communications before sending.

nodes.name: tools.js
nodes.summary: Misc dev tools helpers: profilers, timers, object-size, and small globals exposed under frappe.tools for debugging in the browser console.

nodes.name: urllib.js
nodes.summary: URL helpers: get_url, get_url_arg, get_query_params, url_for_list/form, decode helpers. Used widely by routing and request code.

nodes.name: user.js
nodes.summary: frappe.user singleton: cached access to user profile, roles, permissions, image, full name, abbreviations, and has_role helper used across the desk to gate UI by role.

nodes.name: has_role
nodes.summary: Returns true if the current (or supplied) user has any of the given roles. Accepts string or array.

nodes.name: utils.js
nodes.summary: The largest client-side utility module. Defines dozens of helpers on frappe.utils: HTML escaping, URL parsing, filter_dict, guess_style/guess_colour, scroll helpers, debounce/throttle, deep_equal, copy_to_clipboard, play_sound, get_form_link/get_route_label, setup_timer, build_summary_item, sleep, eval_expression for the calculator, and many UI helpers used throughout the Desk.

nodes.name: filter_dict
nodes.summary: Filters an array/dict of objects by a filter map supporting in/not in/</<=/>/>= operators.

nodes.name: guess_style
nodes.summary: Heuristically maps a status-like text to a Bootstrap style (success, warning, danger, info) based on keyword matching. Used for list indicators.

nodes.name: play_sound
nodes.summary: Plays a named UI sound (error, success, chime, etc.) respecting user sound-mute setting.

nodes.name: throttle
nodes.summary: Underscore-style throttle: limits function invocation to once per wait ms with leading/trailing options.

nodes.name: debounce
nodes.summary: Debounces a function with optional immediate invocation and flush/cancel control methods.

nodes.name: get_form_link
nodes.summary: Builds a desk form URL for a given doctype/name with optional query params, wrapping behavior and html/text output.

nodes.name: get_route_label
nodes.summary: Computes a human-readable label for a Desk route string ('List/Sales Invoice' -> 'Sales Invoice List').

nodes.name: setup_timer
nodes.summary: Starts a live countdown/up timer writing to a DOM element.

nodes.name: deep_equal
nodes.summary: Recursive structural equality check for arrays/objects/primitives used by form dirty detection.

nodes.name: copy_to_clipboard
nodes.summary: Writes a string to clipboard via navigator.clipboard or fallback textarea, shows a toast.

nodes.name: build_summary_item
nodes.summary: Builds the HTML for a report/dashboard summary card (label, value, indicator color).

nodes.name: sleep
nodes.summary: Returns a promise that resolves after N milliseconds.

nodes.name: eval_expression
nodes.summary: Safely evaluates arithmetic expression strings for the AwesomeBar calculator, rejecting non-math characters.
